narrative.intro: Tutor Perini received $252M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Tutor Perini won 13 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $19.4M and obligations up 745.8% year over year. Tutor Perini’s FY2026 total equals the full-year obligations listed for several prior years, compared with $127M in FY21, $222M in FY22, $87.4M in FY23, $68.3M in FY24, and $29.8M in FY25. Tutor Perini’s work in FY2026 is concentrated in a single NAICS market: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounted for $252M. Tutor Perini’s largest buyer in FY2026 is the Department of Homeland Security at $248M. The available figures are obligations, except where table notes specify award-value totals for largest-awards and expiring-contracts, and current-year totals are partial fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: How did Tutor Perini’s obligations change year over year?
sections.body: Tutor Perini’s obligations are up 745.8% year over year. Tutor Perini recorded $252M in FY2026 to date, compared with $29.8M in FY25 and other prior-year totals of $127M in FY21, $222M in FY22, $87.4M in FY23, and $68.3M in FY24. The FY2026 total is a partial fiscal year to date figure.

sections.heading: Who are Tutor Perini’s main buying agencies and markets?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is Tutor Perini’s top buyer at $248M in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior purchased $1.6M, the Department of Defense purchased $1.5M, and the General Services Administration purchased $650K. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the top NAICS market at $252M, followed by Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction at $10K.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Tutor Perini?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security bought the most from Tutor Perini at $248M in FY2026 to date. The Department of the Interior bought $1.6M, the Department of Defense bought $1.5M, and the General Services Administration bought $650K.

faq.q: What does Tutor Perini sell to the government?
faq.a: Tutor Perini sells construction services to the government, primarily in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $252M. Tutor Perini also has obligations in Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction at $10K.
